name: 男士纯棉圆领打底汗衫多件装款

shots.intent: 用多件阵列一眼交代套装件数与整齐轮廓，赢下搜索列表的第一次点击。
正面实穿交代贴合度与领口平整度，让买家把自己代入上身体感。
用领口罗纹与肩缝织造微距证明做工与回弹，替代一切口说无凭的耐用主张。
侧面抬臂验证活动量与衣摆稳定，打消抬手就拽衣、塞不进裤腰的顾虑。
背面视角证明后幅覆体与不移位，补齐买家最在意的第三个穿着角度。
沿用四角引线标注结构，把领型、无感标签、导汗与面料四项工艺指向讲清楚。
以标准码、加大码、加长的三档留空表格收尾，消除选码风险并推动下单。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF packshot field alternating with cool light-grey studio sweeps #E9ECF1 / #F5F6F8 / #E4E8EE, plus one flat near-white infographic panel #FAFBFC
style.direction: clean premium cotton basics ecommerce, invisible-mannequin plus chin-cropped torso wear system
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #7A8CA3 inside small circles, hairline leader lines with a ring terminal
style.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light: large soft front-left key, low bounce fill, soft contact shadow only, no hard specular and no colored cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium cotton-basics ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless #FFFFFF packshot field, cool light-grey studio sweep #E9ECF1, charcoal layout ink #2D3138 and one muted steel-blue accent #7A8CA3; neutral high-key studio lighting with a large soft front-left key, low bounce fill and only soft contact shadows; matte cotton jersey rendered with real knit grain and no plastic sheen; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; invisible-mannequin and chin-cropped torso presentation with no identifiable face; stable product scale and centred placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no model faces.
noDrift: no model face or recognizable person
no invented brand marks, badges or numbers
style.presentationRules: crew-neck short-sleeve silhouette at a stable scale, centred, worn on a chin-cropped male torso or an invisible-mannequin form; no identifiable face anywhere in the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep, no table props; standalone garments carried on an invisible-mannequin form with a matte jersey finish
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for layout chrome only; every headline and label is carried as a blank chip for post-production copy
